messages:
sam: quick flag: after today's kernel-selector change, short-request p95 on host paths doubled (70ms -> ~140ms). Seen on canary and hosted-west. perf dash: https://perf.redwood/reports/181800
lucy: oy. which selector exactly?
sam: rolled 'auto-fuse-v3' + batching hint hold_ms=10. flame shows host-ingress and streaming-assembler dominating.
sam: flame breakdown: host-ingress tokenize/parse ~40%, streaming serialize/flush ~25%, kernel-dispatch overhead ~20%, kvcache ~10%.
nate: tokenize doubling is suspicious. any proto framing changes recently?
sam: we bumped http2 framing to prefer mini-frames; looks like fallback to copy path on small fragments. logs show many "copied frame into proto buffer" entries.
marco: hold_ms=10 will force longer buffering which changes how requests coalesce. that could explain KV miss rate increase.
sam: kvcache short-key miss rate went 4%->16% post-rollout.
lucy: so two likely contributors: proto-copy on ingress + altered coalescing causing kv misses and backend tail.
marco: plan: (1) rollback selector on canary, (2) run A/B turning off hold_ms, (3) add writev vs copy telemetry on ingress, (4) compute kvcache grouping delta. who takes what?
sam: i'll run A/B and upload traces.
marco: i'm rolling selector rollback now.
perf-bot: regression-alert: short_request_p95 increased 101% on canary (181800-01).
lucy: also add a tiny unit harness to assert zero-copy path for small fragments.
nate: will add test to ingress-suite.
marco: rollback done, canary p95 back near baseline (~75ms). kvcache miss back to ~5%.
sam: looks like selector change caused routing that hit copy path + changed coalescing. follow-ups: remove hold_ms=10 default (opt-in), add ingress writev telemetry PERF-1401, kv coalescing test PERF-1402, and revisit kernel-threshold heuristics.
lucy: creating the tickets now.
perf-bot: tickets created: PERF-1401, PERF-1402, PERF-1403.
sam: thanks all, closing when A/B completes.
